name: Portelon
price: Free to browse, $10 a month with agents
notes: Downloads are offered for macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon, Windows 10 or later 64-bit, and Linux x86_64 (Debian, RPM and Arch packages). Browsing is free. Agents get 30 days free with no card needed, then $10 a month covering five computers at once. Official pages checked do not state the engine, licence or a public source repository, and do not mention iOS.
